evidence_items.title: terraphim/fof-bench-lexical-baseline
evidence_items.summary: FOF-Bench lexical baseline and data-quality checks This repo holds a small, reproducible set of checks on MaxDevv/FOF-Bench. FOF-Bench is the benchmark from Focus On Facts: Stylistically Invariant and Factually Sensitive Text Embeddings (Adeola, arXiv:2611.33250). The repo contains no FOF-Bench text. FOF-Bench is CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, so this repo holds only our scripts and the counts they produce. To re-run them, download the splits from the original dataset. evidence_items.title: JiayiZhang14/ChatVE-Bench
evidence_items.summary: ChatVE-Bench Paper | Project Page | Code ChatVE-Bench is a benchmark of multi-turn, conversational video editing. Its sessions of 5 to 8 turns add follow-up edits, revise earlier edits, undo any earlier step, and redo undone edits. Every turn is scored with a checklist built from the expected state of the session. evidence_items.title: LevinShan/300Question-Bench
evidence_items.summary: 300Question-Bench Frozen hazard-prediction benchmark from WAtcher: Watching Ahead for Safe Robotic Manipulation with Efficient World-Action Models (paper, code, project page). Each of the 300 questions gives the current camera views, the robot state, the task and one candidate action chunk, and asks: will executing this chunk cause a physical hazard?
